### Docs-only reminder (non-enforcement)

> **This is a reminder only -- nothing here is automatically enforced.**
> CI/CD in this repo skips automatically for diffs that touch *only*
> `README.md` and/or `garden-advisor-ui/README.md` (see
> `.github/DOCS_ONLY_CI.md`). If this PR is intended to be docs-only, please
> double-check it doesn't also touch source, config, `.github/**`, or any
> other file -- a single non-doc file in the diff means the full CI/CD
> pipeline will run as normal, and a mixed diff mislabeled as "docs-only" by
> a contributor is not caught by any automated check beyond the trigger
> filters themselves.
